A '''psychiatrist''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|medical professional]] who specialized in [[psychiatry]], the study and treatment of mental illness. Doctor [[Gawynn Karastee]] was a psychiatrist who was employed by a [[Prison/Legends|penal institution]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
